conclusion.actual_deny_network: Windows AppContainer without network capabilities is an enforceable candidate, unlike Job Objects or proxy settings. It is not implemented or tested here.
conclusion.smallest_safe_progress_now: Implement the strict, read-only Rust launch-contract exporter model and producer-output receipt validation independently. Both can be tested without Java/network execution or OS policy changes.
conclusion.current_existing_libraries: The locked windows0.62.2 package already includes the required system API definitions. Its Isolation module is not enabled by either direct SFM or teamy-windows declarations. A typed implementation needs only the existing crate's Win32_Security_Isolation feature, not a new package/version. A narrowly reviewed authored userenv FFI can avoid even that feature edit.
conclusion.authority_gap: Both AppContainer routes still need explicit bounded permission to create/remove a private per-user profile, grant its SID access only to private invocation roots, and launch/inspect sandboxed test processes. This review grants none of those effects.
conclusion.no_artificial_blocker: A general OS sandbox and a trusted exact-tool/closed-argument contract are different acceptance claims. Do not label the latter deny-network or block unrelated exporter/source consolidation on the former.

required_os_authority: Create one fresh per-user profile for the owned test invocation; refuse collisions rather than reuse unreviewed profiles.
Grant only that SID read/execute access to private verified SDK/input copies and modify access to private work/output/temp roots; never broaden a user cache, checkout or shared SDK ACL.
Launch suspended with startup attribute and an explicit inherited pipe-handle list, attach a kill-on-close private Job Object before resume, then inspect actual token/capabilities.
After process-tree completion, remove only the exact goal-owned profile and private scoped ACL state with recorded lifecycle.
verification: Parent and nested child actual AppContainer SID/capabilities must match.
With positive outside control, deny IPv4/IPv6 outbound, TCP/UDP and loopback in parent and child. Do not infer denial from absent internet.
Real verified JVM21 and JVM25 must read sealed inputs and write bounded outputs successfully.
Refuse if profile/token/setup/policy probe fails; no plain CreateProcess fallback.
No general malware-containment claim: direct network denial does not alone prove all broker/IPC/administrator channels cannot relay data.

child_tools.scan_method: For the twelve exact current JARs, verify full SHA against the official ledger before read-only ZIP/class-byte inspection. child_tools.scan_limit: A reference count is not call reachability. URLClassLoader can read local files; Gson URL serialization is not a network request. An absence of token matches is not proof against reflection, JDK implementation, native code or future plugins. Broad Runtime-token counts were intentionally omitted because RuntimeException and ordinary runtime APIs would overstate subprocess execution.

fresh_producer_receipt_design.purpose: Allow reviewed fresh NodeOutput classpath consumption without trusting inherited cache-marker/file existence.

current_source_flow_reference.observation: runNode waits for dependencies, starts the producer, tries cache restore, executes its action, calls saveOutputs only if every output is under its workspace, then completes the node.
current_source_flow_reference.limit: Inspected source is not tagged exact2.0.19. The API witnesses above came from the exact verified original JAR. Full original-bytecode flow and javac-only shape checks remain a gate before implementing the hook.

fresh_producer_receipt_design.smallest_existing_hook: Use ExactArtifactManager.resolveClasspath(NodeOutputItem), not CacheManager.saveOutputs. Read item.output().getNode()/id/type/getState/getResultPath through the exact pinned API.
preflight: Require a private invocation ID and exact expected producer/output ID/type declared from the authenticated graph/recipe; reject unknown items before file I/O.
Require producer object identity belongs to this freshly created engine graph, producer state COMPLETED, always-disabled inherited cache restore, and no graph mutation after sealing.
Require an absolute regular output path under the owned fresh work root, exact required archive/type shape, bounded length, no reparse/symlink ancestors and stable read identity.
Batch-preflight every classpath item before copying or opening any generated output; preserve original order and duplicates.
sealing: Copy the fresh producer result once into a create-new invocation-owned private input snapshot, hashing streamed bytes and checking source before/after identity.
Seal that snapshot read-only to the child and bind its byte length/full hash to producer identity, declared inputs/tool/function args and graph/recipe/context identity.
Return only the sealed snapshot path to the classpath consumer, never the mutable workspace output.
After graph completion, rehash declared final results and issue a result receipt; no source locks, original artifact pins or shared caches are rewritten.
fresh_producer_receipt_design.identity_limit: Generated output full SHA is an execution result tied to declared original inputs, not an accepted replacement dependency pin.
independent_tests: Unknown/noncompleted/foreign-engine/from-cache/reparse/outside-work/oversized output refuses with zero copy callbacks.

Different context/SDK/argument/input/producer identities cannot reuse a receipt.
No original/schema2 role bytes change and no named graph/native execution is required for synthetic receipt tests.
